body:
INSTAGRAM
Applied to 30 jobs and lost track of every single one?

Let your inbox keep the tracker for you.
Gmail trigger in n8n, an AI step that classifies each email (applied, interview, rejected or offer), a sheet with one row per application, and a nudge after 7 days of silence.
Bonus: when an interview lands, AI drafts a one-page brief on the company and role.
You can build it in one evening.
Tools: n8n https://n8n.io · Gmail · Google Sheets https://sheets.google.com

Got a boring task? Comment it below and I might automate it in the next episode.
Small business? DM me AUDIT.
